### Quick Tips

- **Pair with plain water:** Mix powders or tablets into a full glass of water so you rehydrate steadily without upsetting your stomach.
- **Watch sugar and ingredients:** Lower-sugar formulas are often easier on a queasy stomach, and some recovery blends include herbs or extracts (like DHM or ginger) that may interact with medications—check labels or ask a pharmacist if unsure.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:3480167938420229732,catalogid:1754715819024181392,gpcid:8484043177270409835,mid:576462575678215484&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:3957861194051809931,catalogid:225459222380085800,gpcid:10196507082875040755,mid:576462917074711152&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4766655462393215082,catalogid:12997586887209651213,gpcid:83117616816804818,mid:576462832991255267&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:7467994949451351949,catalogid:18390581254881812108,gpcid:12521607638897408691,mid:576462671848416419&ibp=oshop)[[5]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:6572045781418951561,catalogid:11553348112834397429,gpcid:12521607638897408691,mid:576462671848416419&ibp=oshop)[[6]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:7373568102237586637,catalogid:1381725602638496049,gpcid:2798107438163203809,mid:576462863115711116&ibp=oshop)

To narrow this down, let me know:

- **How you plan to use it** (before/during drinking or the morning after)
- **Your preferred format** (powder packets, fizzy tablets, liquid shots, or capsules)
- **Any preferences or budget** (sugar-free, flavor, or price range)
